 >_ sshTermy  vdev Idea: Dominik Bornhäußer                                                    ● AI



  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ ↕ Sync between computers                                                                     │
  │ Connections, tunnels, runbooks, AI and all settings are stored as an end-to-end encrypted    │
  │ file at the                                                                                  │
  │ chosen location. The location never sees plain text; DPAPI and master password stay per      │
  │ computer.                                                                                    │
  │ ▌ Location               Folder (cloud)  NAS / WebDAV  off                                   │
  │   Folder                 ~/OneDrive/sshtermy                                                 │
  │   Sync password                                                                              │
  │   Host keys              ○ off                                                               │
  │   Archive                ○ off                                                               │
  │   Command history        ● on                                                                │
  │   Automatic              ● on                                                                │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
  │ Folder = OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud, Syncthing · NAS = Synology, QNAP, Nextcloud directly     │
  │                                                                                              │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Computers in sync                                                                            │
  │  ● golden-pc               1 min ago  ← this computer                                        │
  │  ● macbook                 3 min ago                                                         │
  │  ● uconsole                2 h ago                                                           │
  │  Synced: Connections, folders, tunnels, runbooks, workspaces, schedules (run only on their   │
  │  computer), AI including house rules, all settings and keys.                                 │
  │  Stays here: Sync location, own key paths, shell/port “this computer only”, keys “here       │
  │  only”, passwords in the keychain, team folders, relays, audit, debug, MCP, editor, window   │
  │  font size.                                                                                  │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Live test                                                                                    │
  │ ⠿ checking connection …                                                                      │
